static_vignette: A 41-year-old male with bipolar I disorder, stable on lithium 1200 mg nightly for 6 years, presents with a coarse tremor, nausea, diarrhea and unsteady gait. One week ago his primary care clinician started lisinopril and he has been taking ibuprofen daily for back pain during a heat wave with reduced fluid intake. He is confused about the date. Lithium level 2.9 mmol/L, creatinine 1.9 mg/dL.
